questions.question: In which of the following sports is the term ‘Leg bye’ used?
questions.solution:
correct answer is__** Cricket.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**Leg bye" i**s used in the **sport of cricket.**
 
• In cricket, a leg bye is a** way for the batting team to score runs without the ball hitting the bat.**
